title: Entering Orders

children:
An order is either interfaced from the ERP to the application, or entered 
 from the web (in Trading Partner Management) or the order entry module 
 (in SCALE). Orders represent one customer's request to receive certain items 
 from you. To maintain order integrity, the system does not process orders. 
 Instead, the system creates one or more shipments which contain the order's 
 requests. These shipments are then processed. The order is updated in 
 the ERP to reflect the shipments' processing activities. The Order Entry Window uses a navigation tool called a wizard, which 
 is similar to ones that are used in other Microsoft Windows applications. 
 When you choose the Order Entry option on the desktop, SCALE 
 will ask you to indicate what type of order you want to enter. The system 
 will then display either the Shipment Screen (for single orders) 
 or the Order Entry wizard (for all other order types).
The following is discussed in this topic:

This is the first screen of the Order Entry wizard. You can use this 
 screen to indicate if you are going to enter a single order or multiple 
 orders at a time. Employees can also enter an order using an existing 
 template or from an XML document that was generated by the Trading Partner 
 Management order entry system.

Access the Order 
 Entry Window from the desktop.

Choose the type 
 of order you want to enter:

- Single Order: Choose this 
 option to enter a single order into the system. When you press the Next 
 Button, the system will display the system Shipment Screen. Enter 
 your order into this window and press OK when finished. You could use 
 this method to quickly enter a missed order into the system.

- Multiple Order: Choose this 
 option to enter multiple orders or implement a rollout. Choose the company 
 that the order is for and press the Next Button. The system will display 
 the first screen in the system Order Entry wizard, the Customer/Ship To 
 Selection screen. You can use this wizard to enter the order's ship to 
 addresses, routing information, header information, and item(s).

- Use Template: Choose this 
 option if you want to load a template to enter orders into the Order Entry 
 Window. When you press the Next Button, the system will display the Ship 
 To Selection screen in the wizard (using the information from your template). 
 These templates are created on the Item Selection screen of the Order 
 Entry Window. You can only use/create templates when entering multiple 
 orders.

- Web Order: Choose this option 
 to load a pre-configured order from an XML document. You can use this 
 to validate orders entered into the Trading Partner Management order entry 
 system or by external web users over the web.

- If you are entering a single order, 
 the system will display the Shipment Screen.

- If you are entering multiple orders, the system will display the Order Entry 
 wizard.

This is the second screen of the Order Entry wizard. The system will 
 display this screen if the user has chosen to enter the "multiple 
 orders" option, the "use template" option, or the "web 
 order" option on the Mode Selection screen. The values on the left 
 pane of this window represent the ship to addresses that are eligible 
 for inclusion on this order. The values on the right pane of this screen 
 represents the ship to addresses of the customers that you are creating 
 this order for. The system will default this data from a template if one 
 has been chosen from the Mode Selection screen.

NOTE: To add a new ship to address, select "New Ship To" from 
 the Actions Menu. The system will display the Customer Window

Add a ship to 
 address to the order by choosing:

- Company/Customer/Ship To 
 or a     Ship To Template.

- Ship To Template Button 
 if you want to load a template that contains a batch of ship to addresses. 
 These templates are set up in the Order Ship To Selection Window.

- Import Text File Button 
 to load a text file that was generated by your ERP system. This option 
 will not be available unless you activate the "Import Ship To Addresses" 
 exit point. Ask your consultant for more information.

Press the Add 
 To List Button to add this to the screen's left pane.

Use the Arrow 
 Buttons to add/remove ship to addresses to the right pane of the 
 screen. This pane categorizes the addresses as "manually-selected" 
 or "imported."

To edit a ship-to's address information, 
 right-click a record in the right pane and choose Edit Address. The system 
 will display the Address Edit Window. You can use this window to override 
 the properties of a ship-to address. These changes are for this order 
 only, as they do not update the configuration record for this address. 
 Press OK when finished editing.

Press the Next 
 Button. The system will display the next screen in the wizard.

This is the third screen of the Order Entry wizard. You can use the 
 Routing Selection screen to choose the carrier and delivery date information 
 for your new orders.

Choose how you want the system 
 to ship your order(s):

Select the Carrier/Service 
 Button if you want to assign 
 your order to a specific service.

Select the Carrier Group Button if you want to assign your order to 
 a specific carrier group.

Use the Default Carrier/Service 
 Button & Field to 
 load a customer's default carrier and service (as defined on the Customer 
 Window). Choose the customer name and press the button. The system will 
 load the default values of the customer you choose into the carrier and 
 service fields.

Use the Routing 
 Code Field if you want to associate a routing code (i.e. fragile, hazardous, etc). This is helpful if the system needs to 
 make a special determination over which carrier(s) should be used to ship 
 this order.

Use the Freight Terms Field 
 if you want to associate a freight term with this order.

Choose a Scheduled Ship Date and, 
 if appropriate, a Requested Delivery Date for your order(s).

Press the Next 
 Button. The system will display the next screen in the wizard.

This is the third screen of the Order Entry wizard. You can use the 
 Miscellaneous Selection screen to complete entering order header information. 
 None of the fields on this window are mandatory.

Enter any additional order header 
 information on the Miscellaneous Tab.

Select a Warehouse 
 where the order will be picked. The system will default to the user's 
 current warehouse.

Provide 
 an Order Type if you want to indicate a specific order status, 
 such as "seasonal," "rush," or "emergency."

Add an Order 
 ID Prefix if you want the system to add a prefix to all orders 
 created in the current order entry session. For example, if you entered 
 the value "CMP" in this field, the final shipment ID's for these 
 orders would be "CMP-01", "CMP-02", "CMP-03", 
 etc.

Add a Priority 
 to an order, such as "1" or "2". The system uses this 
 field to determine when it should select or process an order, based on 
 its priority in relation to the other orders that need processing.

Check the 
 Override Customer Check box if you want to bill the order to a different 
 customer than you are shipping to. The system will display a window in 
 which you can search for a different customer to bill to.

Indicate 
 a Process Type if you want to label this order with an additional 
 classification. For example, this field might be defined to indicate what 
 type of monetary processing an order requires (cash or credit card).

If appropriate, associate Customer 
 Category Codes to your order.

Use the Default 
 Categories Button & Field to 
 load a customer's default categories (as defined on the Customer Window). 
 Choose the customer name and press the button. The system will load the 
 default values of the customer you choose into the category fields.

Right-click on the record list 
 and select Add Comments. The system will display the Comment Entry 
 Window.

Choose a comment type and enter 
 your comment's text in the Comment Field. Press the Add Button. 
 The system will list your comment in the record list.

Press OK. 
 The system will store these as header-level comments.

When finished, 
 press the Next Button. The system will display the next screen 
 in the wizard. .

This is the fourth screen of the Order Entry wizard. This screen allows 
 the user to choose the items to be included on the orders. When you are 
 finished entering data in this window, the system will create the orders. 
 Also, you can create special item order entry data template records that 
 can be used the next time you want to enter an order. The values on the 
 left pane of this window represent the items that are eligible for inclusion 
 on this order. The values on the right pane of this screen represent the 
 items that you have included on this order.
NOTE: The order entry process will accept an Inactive item, if there is an alternate item defined on the item master.

Add an item to 
 the order by choosing a Company and Item Number
Choose a order entry Item Template

Press the Add To List Button 
 to add this to the screen's left pane

Enter the Quantity and UM (Unit 
 of Measure) of the item that you want to add to your order.

Use the Arrow Buttons to add the 
 item(s) to the right pane of the screen. This will add the item(s) 
 to your order.

Alternate Items: If there 
 is an alternate item associated to the item you are ordering, the system 
 will prompt you indicating that the current item is obsolete. You can 
 then choose whether or not to add the alternate item to your order.     You will not be able to add the obsolete item to your 
 order.

Substitute Items: The system 
 will alert you that you can add a substitute item to an order if there 
 is not enough quantity available of the original item. You can then choose 
 to add the substitute item to the order, or go ahead and add the original 
 item.

Associate a comment to this item 
 by right-clicking a record in the right pane and choosing Add Comment. 
 The system will display the Comment Entry Window. Enter your comment by 
 choosing a comment type and entering a text value. Press OK. Your comment 
 will be displayed in the record list. The system will store these as detail-level 
 comments.

You can also change the quantity 
 of an item by entering a new value in the Quantity column. The 
 system will pass any changes you make to the quantity value to the shipments 
 you are creating, as well as the template when/if one is chosen.

You can also change the price of 
 an item by entering a new value in the Price column. The system 
 will pass any changes you make to the price value to the shipments you 
 are creating, as well as the template when/if one is chosen.

Use the Save as Template Checkbox 
 if you want to save the current order as a template.

If this check box is checked, the flow of screens in the current 
 order entry session will be saved as a template. When you press Finish, 
 the system will display the Template Name Selection Window. Provide a 
 name and description for your order entry template. Press OK. The system 
 will save your template. You can then load this template in future sessions 
 using the Use Template Button on the first screen of the Order Entry Window.

If this check box is not checked, 
 the system will process the order without saving it as a template.

Use the Create Shipments Checkbox 
 and the Create Orders Checkbox to indicate how the system will 
 process these order(s).     NOTE: The created shipment's status will 
 depend on the "Add From Order Entry" value on the Outbound Status 
 Action Window.

If ONLY the Create Shipments 
 Checkbox is checked, the order entry module will output shipments.

If BOTH the Create Shipments 
 and the Create Orders Checkbox are checked, the order entry module 
 will output shipments AND orders.

Press the Finish Button. 
 The system will create:

Templates: If you selected 
 the Save As Template Checkbox. You can load this template on the mode 
 selection screen when entering future orders.

Shipment(s): If you 
 selected the Create Shipments Checkbox.

Orders AND 
 Shipments: If you selected the Create Shipment and Create Orders 
 Checkboxes.

 your order into this window and press OK when finished. You could use 
 this method to quickly enter a missed order into the system.



- Multiple Order: Choose this 
 option to enter multiple orders or implement a rollout. Choose the company 
 that the order is for and press the Next Button. The system will display 
 the first screen in the system Order Entry wizard, the Customer/Ship To 
 Selection screen. You can use this wizard to enter the order's ship to 
 addresses, routing information, header information, and item(s).



- Use Template: Choose this 
 option if you want to load a template to enter orders into the Order Entry 
 Window. When you press the Next Button, the system will display the Ship 
 To Selection screen in the wizard (using the information from your template). 
 These templates are created on the Item Selection screen of the Order 
 Entry Window. You can only use/create templates when entering multiple 
 orders.



- Web Order: Choose this option 
 to load a pre-configured order from an XML document. You can use this 
 to validate orders entered into the Trading Partner Management order entry 
 system or by external web users over the web.

            
 

            
Press the Next 
 Button.



- If you are entering a single order, 
 the system will display the Shipment Screen.



- If you are entering multiple orders, the system will display the Order Entry 
 wizard.

        

        
 

        
 

        
 2. Ship To Selection Screen...

        
This is the second screen of the Order Entry wizard. The system will 
 display this screen if the user has chosen to enter the "multiple 
 orders" option, the "use template" option, or the "web 
 order" option on the Mode Selection screen. The values on the left 
 pane of this window represent the ship to addresses that are eligible 
 for inclusion on this order. The values on the right pane of this screen 
 represents the ship to addresses of the customers that you are creating 
 this order for. The system will default this data from a template if one 
 has been chosen from the Mode Selection screen.

        
 

        
NOTE: To add a new ship to address, select "New Ship To" from 
 the Actions Menu. The system will display the Customer Window

        

            
Add a ship to 
 address to the order by choosing:



- Company/Customer/Ship To 
 or a     Ship To Template.



OR



- Ship To Template Button 
 if you want to load a template that contains a batch of ship to addresses. 
 These templates are set up in the Order Ship To Selection Window.



OR



- Import Text File Button 
 to load a text file that was generated by your ERP system. This option 
 will not be available unless you activate the "Import Ship To Addresses" 
 exit point. Ask your consultant for more information.

 

            
Press the Add 
 To List Button to add this to the screen's left pane. 

            
 

            
Use the Arrow 
 Buttons to add/remove ship to addresses to the right pane of the 
 screen. This pane categorizes the addresses as "manually-selected" 
 or "imported." 

            
 

            

                
To edit a ship-to's address information, 
 right-click a record in the right pane and choose Edit Address. The system 
 will display the Address Edit Window. You can use this window to override 
 the properties of a ship-to address. These changes are for this order 
 only, as they do not update the configuration record for this address. 
 Press OK when finished editing.

                
 

            

            
Press the Next 
 Button. The system will display the next screen in the wizard.

        

        
 

        
 

        

 3. Routing Selection Screen...

        
This is the third screen of the Order Entry wizard. You can use the 
 Routing Selection screen to choose the carrier and delivery date information 
 for your new orders.

        

            

                
Choose how you want the system 
 to ship your order(s):

                
 

            

            

                

                    
Select the Carrier/Service 
 Button if you want to assign 
 your order to a specific service.

                    
 

                

                

                    
Select the Carrier Group Button if you want to assign your order to 
 a specific carrier group.

                    
 

                

            

            

                
Use the Default Carrier/Service 
 Button & Field to 
 load a customer's default carrier and service (as defined on the Customer 
 Window). Choose the customer name and press the button. The system will 
 load the default values of the customer you choose into the carrier and 
 service fields.

                
 

            

            
Use the Routing 
 Code Field if you want to associate a routing code (i.e. fragile, hazardous, etc). This is helpful if the system needs to 
 make a special determination over which carrier(s) should be used to ship 
 this order.

            

                
 

            

            

                
Use the Freight Terms Field 
 if you want to associate a freight term with this order.

                
 

            

            

                
Choose a Scheduled Ship Date and, 
 if appropriate, a Requested Delivery Date for your order(s). 

                
 

            

            
Press the Next 
 Button. The system will display the next screen in the wizard.

        

        
 

        
 

        
 4. Miscellaneous Selection Screen...

        
This is the third screen of the Order Entry wizard. You can use the 
 Miscellaneous Selection screen to complete entering order header information. 
 None of the fields on this window are mandatory.

        
 

        
General 
 Tab

        

            

                
Enter any additional order header 
 information on the Miscellaneous Tab.

                
 

            

            

                

                    
Select a Warehouse 
 where the order will be picked. The system will default to the user's 
 current warehouse.

                    
 

                

                
Provide 
 an Order Type if you want to indicate a specific order status, 
 such as "seasonal," "rush," or "emergency."

 

                
Add an Order 
 ID Prefix if you want the system to add a prefix to all orders 
 created in the current order entry session. For example, if you entered 
 the value "CMP" in this field, the final shipment ID's for these 
 orders would be "CMP-01", "CMP-02", "CMP-03", 
 etc.

 

                
Add a Priority 
 to an order, such as "1" or "2". The system uses this 
 field to determine when it should select or process an order, based on 
 its priority in relation to the other orders that need processing.

 

                
Check the 
 Override Customer Check box if you want to bill the order to a different 
 customer than you are shipping to. The system will display a window in 
 which you can search for a different customer to bill to.

 

                
Indicate 
 a Process Type if you want to label this order with an additional 
 classification. For example, this field might be defined to indicate what 
 type of monetary processing an order requires (cash or credit card).

            

            
 

            

                
If appropriate, associate Customer 
 Category Codes to your order.

                
 

            

            
Use the Default 
 Categories Button & Field to 
 load a customer's default categories (as defined on the Customer Window). 
 Choose the customer name and press the button. The system will load the 
 default values of the customer you choose into the category fields.

        

        
Comments 
 Tab

        

            

                
Right-click on the record list 
 and select Add Comments. The system will display the Comment Entry 
 Window.

                
 

            

            

                
Choose a comment type and enter 
 your comment's text in the Comment Field. Press the Add Button. 
 The system will list your comment in the record list.

                
 

            

            
Press OK. 
 The system will store these as header-level comments.

 

            
When finished, 
 press the Next Button. The system will display the next screen 
 in the wizard. .

        

        
 

        
 

        
 5. Item Selection Screen...

        
This is the fourth screen of the Order Entry wizard. This screen allows 
 the user to choose the items to be included on the orders. When you are 
 finished entering data in this window, the system will create the orders. 
 Also, you can create special item order entry data template records that 
 can be used the next time you want to enter an order. The values on the 
 left pane of this window represent the items that are eligible for inclusion 
 on this order. The values on the right pane of this screen represent the 
 items that you have included on this order.

        
 

        
NOTE: The order entry process will accept an Inactive item, if there is an alternate item defined on the item master.

        
 

        

            
Add an item to 
 the order by choosing a Company and Item Number



OR



Choose a order entry Item Template





            

                
Press the Add To List Button 
 to add this to the screen's left pane

                
 

            

            

                
Enter the Quantity and UM (Unit 
 of Measure) of the item that you want to add to your order.

                
 

            

            

                
Use the Arrow Buttons to add the 
 item(s) to the right pane of the screen. This will add the item(s) 
 to your order. 

                
 

                
Alternate Items: If there 
 is an alternate item associated to the item you are ordering, the system 
 will prompt you indicating that the current item is obsolete. You can 
 then choose whether or not to add the alternate item to your order.     You will not be able to add the obsolete item to your 
 order.

                
 

                
Substitute Items: The system 
 will alert you that you can add a substitute item to an order if there 
 is not enough quantity available of the original item. You can then choose 
 to add the substitute item to the order, or go ahead and add the original 
 item.

                
 

            

            

                
Associate a comment to this item 
 by right-clicking a record in the right pane and choosing Add Comment. 
 The system will display the Comment Entry Window. Enter your comment by 
 choosing a comment type and entering a text value. Press OK. Your comment 
 will be displayed in the record list. The system will store these as detail-level 
 comments.

                
 

            

            

                
You can also change the quantity 
 of an item by entering a new value in the Quantity column. The 
 system will pass any changes you make to the quantity value to the shipments 
 you are creating, as well as the template when/if one is chosen.

                
 

            

            

                
You can also change the price of 
 an item by entering a new value in the Price column. The system 
 will pass any changes you make to the price value to the shipments you 
 are creating, as well as the template when/if one is chosen.

                
 

            

            

                
Use the Save as Template Checkbox 
 if you want to save the current order as a template.

                
 

            

            

                

                    
If this check box is checked, the flow of screens in the current 
 order entry session will be saved as a template. When you press Finish, 
 the system will display the Template Name Selection Window. Provide a 
 name and description for your order entry template. Press OK. The system 
 will save your template. You can then load this template in future sessions 
 using the Use Template Button on the first screen of the Order Entry Window.

                    
 

                

                

                    
If this check box is not checked, 
 the system will process the order without saving it as a template.

                    
 

                

            

            

                
Use the Create Shipments Checkbox 
 and the Create Orders Checkbox to indicate how the system will 
 process these order(s).     NOTE: The created shipment's status will 
 depend on the "Add From Order Entry" value on the Outbound Status 
 Action Window.

                
 

            

            

                

                    
If ONLY the Create Shipments 
 Checkbox is checked, the order entry module will output shipments.

                    
 

                

                

                    
If BOTH the Create Shipments 
 and the Create Orders Checkbox are checked, the order entry module 
 will output shipments AND orders.

                    
 

                

            

            

                
Press the Finish Button. 
 The system will create:

                
 

            

            

                

                    
Templates: If you selected 
 the Save As Template Checkbox. You can load this template on the mode 
 selection screen when entering future orders.

                    
 

                

                

                    
Shipment(s): If you 
 selected the Create Shipments Checkbox. 

                    
 

                

                
Orders AND 
 Shipments: If you selected the Create Shipment and Create Orders 
 Checkboxes.
